claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the time delay comprises a time delay for the host device to observe before issuing a subsequent read command for the same set of data.
3. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

determining, based at least in part on the set of data being absent from the buffer, a latency for satisfying the read command; and determining a duration (425; 430) of the time delay based at least in part on the latency for satisfying the read command, wherein the indication of the time delay indicates the duration of the time delay.

4. The method of claim 3, further comprising: determining that the latency for satisfying the read command is greater than a latency expected by the host device, wherein the indication of the time delay is sent based at least in part on the determination that the latency for satisfying the read command is greater than the latency expected by the host device.

5. The method of claim 3, wherein the indication comprises one or more pulses (420) on a pin of a memory device (105; 220) that includes the interface controller, and wherein the duration of the time delay is indicated based at least in part on a quantity of the one or more pulses, a length of the one or more pulses, a pattern of the one or more pulses, or any combination thereof.

6. The method of claim 1, further comprising: retrieving, based at least in part on the set of data being absent from the buffer, the set of data from a non-volatile memory coupled with the interface controller, wherein a duration (425; 430) of the time delay is based at least in part on a latency associated with retrieving the set of data from the non-volatile memory.

7. The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, based at least in part on the read command, an activity level of the interface controller associated with servicing one or more access commands received from the host device before the read command, wherein a duration (425; 430) of the time delay is based at least in part on the activity level of the interface controller.
8. The method of claim 1, wherein the indication of the time delay is associated with a duration of time configured at the host device.
9. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

determining that the set of data is stored in a non-volatile memory (225; 325) coupled with the interface controller (120; 230; 530); and transferring the set of data from the non-volatile memory to the buffer based at least in part on the read command.
10. The method of claim 9, further comprising:

receiving, from the host device, a second read command for the set of data after a duration greater than or equal to the time delay; and transferring the set of data from the buffer to the host device based at least in part on the second read command, wherein the set of data is transferred according to a latency expected by the host device.
11. The method of claim 1, wherein the read command is received by a memory device (220) that comprises the buffer and the interface controller.
12. A method, comprising:
13. The method of claim 12, wherein the time delay is for the host device to observe before issuing a subsequent write command for the same set of data.
14. An apparatus, comprising:

15. The apparatus of claim 14, further comprising: a second bus (275) coupled with the interface controller and configured to convey data pulses to the host device, wherein the interface controller is configured to transmit the indication concurrent with one or more data pulses.
